texts: Eleven free 3D tools for Claude Code and any MCP client, from one address

Add one address to Claude Code or any MCP client and the assistant gets eleven free 3D tools, with no account or key: text or an image to a textured model, rigged avatars, rigging, refinement, and look_at_model, which renders a model so the assistant can check its own work. The write-up includes a real session against the server.

posts: Add one address to Claude Code or any MCP client and the assistant gets a set of free 3D tools, with no account or key: text or an image to a textured GLB, rigged and animation-ready avatars, rigging a model you already have, refinement by describing the change, and look_at_model, which renders up to six angles of any public GLB so the assistant can check its own work and regenerate with the fault named. The write-up includes a real session run against the server with no credentials.
altText: A vintage film camera rendered in the browser 3D viewer against a dark background, seen from the front three-quarter angle with its three-lens turret, speed dial and textured olive body; the model is the one the look_at_model tool inspected in the session described in the article
